facts: Serve and Grubhub announced robot delivery beginning in Chicago, Los Angeles and Alexandria.
Announcement stated more than 100 participating Grubhub merchants in Chicago and nearly 200 in Los Angeles.
Serve also announced San Jose and Washington DC expansion, a Miami micro-depot, merchant hardware, advertising service and Moxi 2.0 hospital robot.
Q2 revenue was $3.2 million, up 404% year over year and 9% sequentially.
Recurring revenue exceeded 50% of total revenue.
FY2026 revenue guidance was revised to $9-$10 million because of lower-than-expected Uber Eats delivery volume and removal of projected second-half demand.
FY2026 non-GAAP operating-expense guidance was reduced to $140-$150 million.
Cash and marketable securities were $240.4 million at June 30, 2026.
